name: 22773-longprefill-step35flashfp8-tp8
model: stepfun-ai/Step-3.5-Flash-FP8. Ungated; ~209 GB, not in the local HF cache, so one download precedes the first run.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, NVLink, ONE node. No router, no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=8, EP=4 (so moe_tp_size=2), DP=1, PP=1. EP=4 is required by the checkpoint's block-FP8 shapes, not a tuning choice.
architecture: 199.4B block-FP8 MoE decoder, 45 layers (3 dense, 42 MoE with 288 experts top-8 plus a shared expert), hybrid full/512-token-sliding attention; ~26 GB per card at TP8.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 384 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, leaving ~288 scored.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix sharing: 8192 prompt tokens in, 8 output tokens out, both fixed (stdev 0), `temperature: 0.0`, `ignore_eos: true`.
purpose: A document analysis service digesting 8,000-token filings into brief verdicts for 32 concurrent users on eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang launch arguments. Eight GPUs of one node, 199B block-FP8 MoE, TP8 + EP4.

# ~209 GB over 44 safetensors shards, not cached here: one download before the first run.
model-path: stepfun-ai/Step-3.5-Flash-FP8

# The config class ships with the checkpoint (`auto_map.AutoConfig`), so the config object needs
# remote code even though the model implementation is native to this engine.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 8

# NOT OPTIONAL. ep 4 gives moe_tp_size 2 and a per-rank expert intermediate of 1280/2 = 640. At
# ep 1 it is 1280/8 = 160 and the block-FP8 weight loader refuses on
# `intermediate_size_per_partition % block_n != 0` (block_n 128) -- the server does not start.
ep-size: 4

mem-fraction-static: 0.75

chunked-prefill-size: 16384

# Load time only: 8 -> 64 threads reading the 44 shards over NFS. Must stay on ONE line.
model-loader-extra-config: {"enable_multithread_load": true, "num_threads": 64}
